description: Add a health condition to the user's private Conditions (owner only, never shared), in their own words: name ("Blurry near vision"), symptoms, body_area ("left eye"), started_on (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), status (suspected by default; active, improving or resolved), tracking_focus. Never diagnose or name a condition they didn't. An open condition with the same name comes back unchanged. For how it is today, follow with log_condition_checkin. ($0.10; API key required)

name.description: What the user calls it, in their words (e.g. "Blurry near vision"). Never a diagnosis they did not give.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

started_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD it started (onset). Default for a new one: today.

status.description: suspected (default for a new one) | active | improving | resolved.

symptoms.description: What they notice, e.g. "Blurry at near distance, worse in the evening".

tracking_focus.description: What to watch on each check-in.

treatments.description: What they use or do for it.

name: create_condition

already_existed.description: true: an open condition with this name exists; it came back unchanged.

condition.description: An owner health condition: condition_id, name, status, confirmed, sensitivity, symptoms, body_area, started_on, resolved_on, tracking_focus, treatments, notes, latest_checkin.

idempotent_replay.description: true when this request_id already ran: the first result, nothing new written.

title: Add Condition
